findings.subject: rating
findings.summary: Rating's stars fail non-text contrast in light mode, and on vs off differs by hue only.
findings.evidence: rating.css:11-12 on = --a63-category-amber = --color-warning-500 rgb(243,159,0), about 2.1:1 on the light page; off = --a63-text-secondary at 35%, about 1.3:1 from the on colour; both are solid glyphs (rating.css:48-53). The pair is not declared in packages/styles/src/tokens/contrast.browser.test.ts. Visible in apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-rating-input-chromium-linux.png.
findings.fix: Draw off stars as outlines (fill: none; stroke at --a63-border-input or text-secondary, as the forced-colors rule at rating.css:113-115 already does), and use an on colour that reaches 3:1 on page and panel (--a63-status-warning, which the contrast test already holds at 3:1, or a darker amber step); add the on/page and off/page pairs to the contrast test.

findings.subject: segmented-control
findings.summary: SegmentedControl exposes tabs with no tab panels and a tablist that cannot be named.
findings.evidence: segmented-control.tsx:66-111 renders Tabs.Root/List/Tab, so each segment is role=tab with nothing to control; ...props (aria-label) go to the role-less Tabs.Root div (segmented-control.test.tsx:97-113 asserts this), never to the tablist. The generated docs page says so: 'the current component API does not expose a name for the containing tab list. Treat group naming as an implementation gap'. Maturity is stable (segmented-control.json).
findings.fix: Render it as a single-select radio group (Base UI RadioGroup/Radio or ToggleGroup with aria-pressed) with the sliding indicator kept, forward aria-label/aria-labelledby to the group element, bind an APG pattern (radio) in the contract so patterns.test.ts plays it; or, if tabs are kept, require and wire panels.

findings.subject: segmented-control
findings.summary: Root props land on a role-less wrapper and segments cannot take their own props.
findings.evidence: segmented-control.tsx:66-67 spreads props onto Tabs.Root; Tabs.List (:83) takes none; SegmentedControlItem (:14-19) is data-only; each tab also gets title={item.label} (:91), a native tooltip duplicating a visible label in the label variant.
findings.fix: Forward ARIA props to the group element, allow per-item extra props (or a render prop), and set title only in the icon variant.

findings.subject: progress
findings.summary: Progress parts accept a state-function className in their types but silently drop it.
findings.evidence: progress.tsx:14,44-94 use Base UI Props unchanged, whose className is string | ((state) => string) (node_modules/@base-ui/react/internals/types.d.ts:26), then pass it to cn() (packages/ui-react/src/lib/cn.ts, clsx ignores functions). Checkbox/Radio/Switch avoid this with Omit<..., 'className'> & { className?: string } (checkbox.tsx:9). Same defect in SliderValue (slider.tsx:131-139).
findings.fix: Either Omit className and re-type it as string like the other parts, or resolve a function className with Base UI's state before merging.

findings.subject: slider
findings.summary: Slider drops the render prop and SliderValue drops function classNames.
findings.evidence: slider.tsx:19-22 Omit<SliderRootProps, ... 'render'>; slider.tsx:131-139 SliderValue passes Base UI className through cn().
findings.fix: Keep `render` on SliderProps (it already spreads ...props onto SliderPrimitive.Root) and type SliderValue className as string.

findings.subject: rating
findings.summary: Rating input is controlled-only and `disabled` is ignored when read-only.
findings.evidence: rating.tsx:12 `value: number` required, no defaultValue; rating.tsx:47-75 read-only branch ignores `disabled`; rating.tsx:86 casts div props onto RadioGroup.
findings.fix: Add defaultValue with internal state (value optional), and either document or drop `disabled` for the read-only form.

findings.subject: spinner
findings.summary: Spinner has no props type, no decorative mode and injects a <style> per instance.
findings.evidence: spinner.tsx:27 raw svg props, no SpinnerProps ('Types: None.' from `atom63 component spinner`); chat-steps.tsx:80 must pass aria-hidden aria-label={undefined} role={undefined}; spinner.tsx:5-25,39 one <style> per instance.
findings.fix: Export SpinnerProps with `label` (default 'Loading') and a decorative option that drops role and name; move the keyframes to spinner.css like every other recipe.

findings.subject: spinner
findings.summary: Spinner's live region is an SVG with only an aria-label, so it may never be announced.
findings.evidence: spinner.tsx:30-34 role=status + aria-label on <svg>; status announcements come from content changes, and the region has no text; every spinner is its own live region.
findings.fix: Make the SVG aria-hidden and, when not decorative, wrap it in a span role=status containing visually hidden label text; let surrounding components own the live region.

findings.subject: slider
findings.summary: Slider has no forced-colors treatment or capture, and no APG pattern test.
findings.evidence: slider.css:33-51 rail and fill are background-color only, which forced colors replace; no forced-colors block and no ForcedColors story (compare progress.css:95-100, radio.css:126). packages/ui-foundation/src/a11y/index.ts:46-56 has no slider pattern.
findings.fix: Add a forced-colors block (rail border CanvasText, fill Highlight with forced-color-adjust: none) and a ForcedColors story; add an APG slider pattern and bind slider.json to it.

findings.subject: slider
findings.summary: Slider's unfilled rail nearly disappears in dark modes.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-slider-themes-chromium-linux.png modern/dark and terminal/dark rows: rail is --a63-surface-muted on the panel (slider.css:38) and barely visible; aqua/retro dark show a 1px inset line with a hook at the end; dark thumb (--a63-surface-overlay) is low contrast on the dark page.
findings.fix: Give the rail a visible boundary in dark (hairline --a63-border-input or a stronger track token) and check thumb/page contrast; provisional until YZ sees the contact sheet.

findings.subject: rating
findings.summary: Rating looks identical in all four themes and its Themes story is unlabelled.
findings.evidence: ui-react-rating-themes-chromium-linux.png: 8 rows of the same amber stars, no theme/mode labels (rating.stories.tsx:70-84), unlike every other Themes story in this batch.
findings.fix: Label rows like the other Themes stories; YZ to decide whether the rating should express the theme archetype (e.g. terminal glyph, retro bevel).

findings.subject: batch 2 (all eight)
findings.summary: No baseline captures hover, focus-visible, pressed or dragging, though contracts list them.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/commands.ts:1-23 only moves the pointer away and toggles forced colors; no story in scope has a play function. Uncaptured contract states: switch hover/pressed/focus-visible, radio focus-visible, segmented-control hover/focus-visible, slider focus-visible/dragging, rating hover/focus-visible.
findings.fix: Add a visual command that focuses (keyboard) and hovers a target, plus one InteractionStates story per control, so the designed rings and hovers are kept by baselines.

findings.subject: spinner
findings.summary: Spinner has no size axis; its Sizes story uses inline pixel styles.
findings.evidence: spinner.json has no sizes; spinner.tsx:15-16 fixed 1rem; spinner.stories.tsx:22-30 style={{ height: 12/20/32 }}.
findings.fix: Add sizes to the contract (e.g. sm/md/lg mapped to --a63-control-icon-size-*) or make it follow 1em, and drop the inline styles from the story.

findings.subject: segmented-control
findings.summary: Right-to-left behaviour of the sliding indicator is unverified.
findings.evidence: segmented-control.css:164-181 positions with `left: 0` + translateX(var(--active-tab-left)); no RightToLeft story or baseline (switch and slider have one).
findings.fix: Add a RightToLeft story under UIProvider dir=rtl with a baseline (and a long CJK label case).

findings.subject: rating
findings.summary: Rating's star names are hard-coded English with no override.
findings.evidence: rating.tsx:90 aria-label `1 star` / `${star} stars`; rating.tsx:50 default `${value} out of ${max}`; only the group/image label is a prop.
findings.fix: Add a getItemLabel(star, max) prop (and use it for the read-only default) so localized apps can name the radios.

findings.subject: progress
findings.summary: The indeterminate sweep does not mirror in right-to-left, and nothing captures RTL.
findings.evidence: progress.css:66-73 keyframes translateX(-100%) to translateX(250%); no RTL story.
findings.fix: Flip the keyframes under :dir(rtl) (as switch.css:127 does) and add a RightToLeft story.

findings.subject: spinner
findings.summary: Spinner's docs cannot tell a builder how to size, label or hide it.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 component spinner`: 'Types: None.', no sizing or labelling guidance; Sizes example uses inline styles.
findings.fix: Document the props added in r2-k02-choice-7/17 with a decorative-inside-a-button example.

findings.subject: rating
findings.summary: Rating input behaviour beyond a click is untested.
findings.evidence: rating.test.tsx has 3 tests; no arrow-key, disabled or rounding test; rating.tsx:85 checks Math.round(value) while :92 lights stars <= value (2.5 checks 3 but lights 2); rating.json binds no APG pattern though the input is a radio group.
findings.fix: Bind rating.json to the radio pattern (Input story), add disabled and keyboard tests, and decide the rounding rule.

findings.subject: spinner
findings.summary: Spinner tests cover attributes only.
findings.evidence: spinner.test.tsx: 2 tests; nothing on label override, decorative use or reduced motion.

findings.subject: slider
findings.summary: Neutral tone paints a text token as a fill (slider baselined; progress hides it behind a custom property).
findings.evidence: craft-baseline.json `token-role | slider.css | background-color: var(--a63-text-primary)` (slider.css:50); progress.css:51 `--progress-fill: var(--a63-text-primary)` used as background-color at :39, which the role check does not see.
findings.fix: Add a neutral fill token in the selection/track contract (or use --a63-action-neutral) for both, then remove the baseline entry.

findings.subject: switch
findings.summary: Switch and Rating hover rules are not limited to hover-capable pointers.
findings.evidence: switch.css:137 and rating.css:83-88 use :hover outside @media (hover: hover), unlike checkbox.css:94 and radio.css:96, so hover sticks after a tap.
findings.fix: Wrap them in @media (hover: hover).

findings.subject: checkbox
findings.summary: Checkbox has no forced-colors rule or capture, unlike Radio.
findings.evidence: checkbox.css has no @media (forced-colors: active); no ForcedColors story; radio.css:124-136 and ui-react-radio-forced-colors-chromium-linux.png do.
findings.fix: Add a ForcedColors story (reuse States) and, if the checked box loses its fill, map it to Highlight as radio does.

findings.subject: slider
findings.summary: Shared form guidance tells builders to validate an invalid state Slider and Rating do not have.
findings.evidence: `atom63 component slider` and `atom63 component rating` both print 'Validate focus visibility, disabled state, invalid state, and touch input together.'; neither contract lists invalid. Rating's catalog summary says 'out of five stars' though max is a prop (component-catalog.ts:493).
findings.fix: Make the shared guidance line conditional on the contract's states, and say 'out of max (5 by default)'.
